guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own numbers in the yellow cells: maker pay, target margin, lowest margin, fragrance load, card fee, marketplace fee, overhead per unit and sales tax.
Keep Materials current: type the cost per kilogram or piece. Formula lines, Products and every margin update at once.

Check Formula lines for each product (quantity in kilograms or pieces for one batch, a batch being one production run with its own batch number), then read Products: unit cost, full cost, margins and the price for your target.
Margin means profit as a share of the price. Retail margin is after materials and labour; the Price list shows the margin after the channel fee and the shipping you absorb.
Record every batch on Batch cost sheets: the cost per good unit and the gap to the standard cost fill in. Yield means good units as a share of planned units.
Record the wax and fragrance weights on Fragrance loads. The load is the fragrance weight as a share of the wax weight, checked against your target.
Use Lye sheets and the Lye and water sheet as plain arithmetic on the factors from your own supplier sheet. Check your own local rules for labels and safety.
Log every price change on Price changes and every supplier change on Ingredient price changes. The last change dates feed Products and Materials.
Check Discount rules, Shipping bands, Packaging kits and Comparable products before a sale, a new courier rate or a price review.
Run Price tests: units before and during, the unit change and the profit change show whether a new price paid.
Cure days are the days a candle or soap rests before it is ready. Wholesale means selling to shops at about half the retail price. Labour minutes of a gift set include the labour of its parts.

Use the 14 calculators before you decide: batch cost, fragrance load, lye and water, full cost, prices by channel, minimum price, discount, gift set, ingredient rise, free shipping, scaling and a what-if grid.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to open a chat with the text already written (28 messages).
Read the Costing and Pricing Dashboard and Charts every week: margins by category and channel, batches above standard, overhead per unit, fragrance load, ingredient rises and price tests.

listing.title: Handmade Candle, Soap and Body Care Costing and Pricing Excel Template: Batch Costing, Margins by Channel, Fragrance Load, Price Tests
listing.headline: Know what every candle, soap and balm costs and what to charge
listing.description:
Price every candle, soap bar and body-care product from its formula in one Excel workbook. Formula lines take today's material prices, and Products shows the material, labour and full cost, the retail and wholesale margin (profit as a share of the price), the price for your target margin and the margin in every channel for all 24 products.

Batch cost sheets show each batch (one production run with its own batch number) with its cost per good unit and the gap to the standard cost. Fragrance loads check the weight of fragrance against the weight of wax, and Lye sheets do the plain arithmetic of lye and water from the factors you type from your own supplier sheet. They are not recipes and make no safety claim.

The Price list shows the margin after the channel fee and shipping for your online shop, online marketplace, craft fairs and wholesale (selling to shops at about half the retail price). Price changes, Ingredient price changes, Discount rules, Shipping bands, Packaging kits, Overhead by month, Comparable products, Gift set lines and Price tests show where margin is won and lost.

14 calculators cover batch cost, fragrance load, lye and water, full cost, retail and wholesale price, marketplace price, minimum price and break-even, discount impact, gift set price, ingredient price impact, free shipping, scaling a formula and a what-if grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready messages with the details already written in.

This is part one of the Handmade Product Maker suite. A standard Excel workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Money is shown in one plain currency. It helps you plan and does not promise results.

signature.name: Batch cost sheet with the gap to standard
signature.why: every batch shows its cost per good unit against the standard cost of the product, so a batch that used too much wax or too many hours is flagged the same day

signature.name: Full cost per unit with overhead and packaging
signature.why: materials, labour minutes, the overhead per unit and the packaging add up to the cost that a price has to cover, for all 24 products

signature.name: Margin after channel fee and shipping
signature.why: each product and channel shows the fee, the shipping you absorb and the margin left, with the lowest price that keeps your minimum margin

signature.name: Fragrance load check on every batch
signature.why: wax and fragrance weights give the load (fragrance weight as a share of wax weight), the gap to the target and the fragrance cost of the batch

signature.name: Lye and water arithmetic sheet
signature.why: oil weights, the factors from your own supplier sheet, a discount and a water ratio give the lye and water in grams as plain arithmetic, never a recipe claim

signature.name: Gift set price builder
signature.why: components, box, tissue and assembly minutes give the cost of a set, the price for your margin and the saving the customer sees against buying the parts

signature.name: Ingredient price change impact
signature.why: a new cost per kilogram becomes a cost per unit, a lower margin and the price rise needed, before you decide to raise a price or to absorb it

signature.name: Free shipping threshold planner
signature.why: the courier cost, the shipping you charge and your margin give the order value where free shipping still pays, next to the amount you use now

signature.name: Discount impact calculator
signature.why: a discount shows the margin after it, the profit lost on each sale and the extra units you must sell to earn the same profit

signature.name: Minimum price and break-even by product
signature.why: the lowest price with no loss, the lowest price for your minimum margin and the units a month that cover your fixed costs

signature.name: Price tests with the profit change
signature.why: units before and during a test at a new price give the unit change and the change in profit, so a price rise that cost more sales than it earned is visible

signature.name: Shipping bands against the courier cost
signature.why: each method and weight band compares the price you charge with the courier cost and marks the bands that lose money

competitors.lacks: costs one product at a time from typed prices; no batch variance, no channel fees or shipping, no fragrance load check and no price history
tracks stock for a monthly fee but does not turn a price rise into a margin, a minimum price or a price for each sales channel
lists orders and totals but has no formula lines, no batch costing and cannot say what a candle, a soap bar or a gift set really costs
adds up spending by month but never spreads overhead over the units made or connects a material price to the price of a product
loses old costs, forgets which material rose and cannot show which products are under your minimum margin

messages.moment: Supplier: send your new price list
messages.text: Hello {contact}, please send your new price list. We update our costs every month. Thank you.

messages.moment: Supplier: can you match the quote
messages.text: Hello, can you match another quote for {material}? Our last cost was {new_cost}. Thank you.

messages.moment: Supplier: the rise needs a new quote
messages.text: Hello, the price of {material} rose from {old_cost} to {new_cost}. Please send us a new quote.

messages.moment: Supplier: a quote for a larger quantity
messages.text: Hello, please quote a larger quantity of {name}. We pay {unit_cost} now and the pack size is {pack_size}.

messages.moment: Supplier: confirm the pack size and cost
messages.text: Hello, please confirm the pack size ({pack_size}) and the cost ({unit_cost}) of {name}. Thank you.

messages.moment: Maker: use the new formula
messages.text: Hello {maker}, please use the new formula for {product} from the next batch. The standard unit cost is {standard_cost}.

messages.moment: Maker: the batch cost was above standard
messages.text: Hello {maker}, batch {batch_no} of {product} cost {cost_per_good} per good unit against {standard_cost}. Please check the weights next time.

messages.moment: Maker: recheck the fragrance load
messages.text: Hello {maker}, the fragrance load of {product} was {load_pct} against a target of {target_load}. Please weigh it again.

messages.moment: Maker: weigh the lye and water again
messages.text: Hello {maker}, before the batch of {product}: lye {lye_g} grams and water {water_g} grams. Please weigh both again.

messages.moment: Maker: the new batch size
messages.text: Hello {maker}, the new batch size for {product} is {planned_units} units. Please plan your next batch on that size.

messages.moment: Packer: the new packaging kit cost
messages.text: Hello, the cost of the {kit} is now {cost_per_order} per order. Please use the new kit.

messages.moment: Packer: use the gift box from today
messages.text: Hello, please use the gift box for {name} from today. Its unit cost is {unit_cost}.

messages.moment: Shop assistant: update the shop price
messages.text: Hello, please update the price of {product} to {price} in this channel: {channel}.

messages.moment: Shop assistant: new marketplace price
messages.text: Hello, the new marketplace price of {product} is {price} from {changed_on}. Please update the listing.

messages.moment: Shop assistant: the discount code ends
messages.text: Hello, the discount rule {rule} ends on {valid_until}. Please remove it from the shop that day.

messages.moment: Shop assistant: shipping prices changed
messages.text: Hello, the price for the {method} up to {up_to_g} grams is now {price_charged}. Please update the web shop and the free shipping amount.

messages.moment: Market assistant: new price card
messages.text: Hello, the fair price of {product} is {price} from {changed_on}. Please update the price card.

messages.moment: Market assistant: the market day offer
messages.text: Hello, the offer {rule} runs from {valid_from} to {valid_until}: {discount_pct} off. Please update the stall signs.

messages.moment: Owner: the margin is below the minimum
messages.text: Hello, the retail margin of {name} is {retail_margin}, which is below the minimum. Please check the price or the formula.

messages.moment: Owner: a product loses money
messages.text: Hello, {product} in this channel: {channel} leaves {margin_amt} per sale after fee and shipping. Please check the price.

messages.moment: Owner: ingredient costs rose
messages.text: Hello, {material} rose by {change_pct} to {new_cost}. Please check which prices need to change.

messages.moment: Owner: the weekly price review is ready
messages.text: Hello, the weekly price review is ready. For example {name}: margin {retail_margin}, price for your target {price_target}.

messages.moment: Owner: a price test has ended
messages.text: Hello, the price test on {product} ends on {end_date}: units changed by {unit_change} and profit by {profit_change}.

messages.moment: Owner: overhead per unit went up
messages.text: Hello, the overhead per unit for {month} was {overhead_per_unit}, which is {vs_setting} against your setting.

messages.moment: Accountant: the new price list
messages.text: Hello, the new price list is ready. For example {name} is {retail_price} before sales tax. Please tell us if you need the full list.

messages.moment: Accountant: cost summary for the month
messages.text: Hello, the cost summary for {month} is ready: overhead {total_overhead} on {units_made} units made.

messages.moment: Accountant: the overhead split is ready
messages.text: Hello, the overhead split for {month} is ready: rent {rent}, marketing {marketing}, other {other}.

messages.moment: Accountant: confirm the sales tax share
messages.text: Hello, please confirm the sales tax share on the new prices. For example {name}: {retail_price} before sales tax.

zh.Margin means profit as a share of the pr: 保证金是指利润占价格的比例。零售利润是扣除材料和人工之后的； 价格表 显示扣除渠道费用和您承担的运费后的利润。
zh.Record every batch on Batch cost sheets:: 在 批量成本表 上记录每个批次：填写每个合格单位的成本以及与标准成本的差距。产量是指合格单位占计划单位的比例。
zh.Record the wax and fragrance weights on: 记录 香味负载 上的蜡和香料重量。负载量是香料重量占蜡重量的比例，根据您的目标进行检查。
zh.Use Lye sheets and the Lye and water she: 使用 碱液片 和 碱液和水片 作为您自己的供应商表中的因素的简单算术。检查您当地的标签和安全规则。
zh.Log every price change on Price changes: 在 价格变化 上记录每个价格变化，在 原料价格变化 上记录每个供应商变化。最后更改日期提供产品和材料。
zh.Check Discount rules, Shipping bands, Pa: 在促销、新的快递费率或价格审核前检查折扣规则、运输带、包装套件和同类产品。
zh.Run Price tests: units before and during: 运行价格测试：之前和期间的单位，单位变化和利润变化显示是否支付了新的价格。

zh.Use the 14 calculators before you decide: 在做出决定之前，请使用 14 个计算器：批量成本、香料用量、碱液和水、全部成本、渠道价格、最低价格、折扣、礼品套装、成分上涨、免费送货、缩放和假设网格。

ru.Note the reasons on Price changes: Обратите внимание на причины на Изменения цен
ru.Set the price for your target margin: Установите цену для вашей целевой маржи
ru.Note every rise above 3 percent: Обратите внимание на каждое повышение выше 3 процентов.
ru.Read the effect on the product margins: Узнайте, как это повлияет на прибыльность продукта
ru.Ask the suppliers about the biggest rise: Спросите поставщиков о самом большом росте
ru.Write the price change on Price changes: Запишите изменение цены на Изменения цен
ru.Check the first orders at the new price: Проверьте первые заказы по новой цене
ru.Update the overhead of the three months: Обновление накладных расходов за три месяца
ru.Check the margin with the discount calcu: Проверьте маржу с помощью калькулятора скидок
ru.Change the prices that need it: Измените цены, которые в этом нуждаются
ru.Write both weights on Fragrance loads: Запишите оба веса на Ароматные нагрузки
ru.Read the load and the gap to the target: Считайте нагрузку и разрыв до цели
ru.Weigh again if the gap is over your limi: Взвесьте еще раз, если разрыв превышает ваш лимит.
ru.List the products not re-priced for 12 m: Перечислите продукты, цены на которые не будут переоценены в течение 12 месяцев.
ru.Read the year of price and cost changes: Читать год цен и изменений затрат
ru.Set next year prices for each category: Установите цены на следующий год для каждой категории
ru.Products at or above the target margin: Продукты на уровне целевой прибыли или выше нее
ru.Batches at or under standard cost: Партии по стандартной стоимости или ниже
ru.Shipping bands that cover their cost: Доставка ленты, которые покрывают их стоимость
ru.Margin after fee and shipping by channel: Маржа после комиссии и доставки по каналу
ru.Batch cost per good unit against standar: Себестоимость годной единицы к норме по месяцам
ru.Batches above standard cost by month: Партии сверх стандартной стоимости по месяцам
ru.Overhead per unit by month: Накладные расходы на единицу по месяцам
ru.Ingredient price rises by month: Цены на ингредиенты растут каждый месяц
ru.Ingredient price change by category: Изменение цен на ингредиенты по категориям
ru.Open Start and type your company name an: Откройте «Пуск» и введите название своей компании и свои цифры в желтых ячейках: оплата производителю, целевая маржа, минимальная маржа, количество ароматизаторов, комиссия за карту, комиссия за торговую площадку, накладные расходы на единицу продукции и налог с продаж.
ru.Keep Materials current: type the cost pe: Держите материалы в актуальном состоянии: введите стоимость за килограмм или штуку. Строки формулы, Продукты и каждое обновление прибыли одновременно.
ru.Check Formula lines for each product (qu: Проверьте Строки формулы для каждого продукта (количество в килограммах или штуках для одной партии, партия представляет собой один производственный цикл с собственным номером партии), затем прочитайте «Продукты: себестоимость единицы продукции, полная себестоимость, прибыль и цена для вашей цели».
ru.Margin means profit as a share of the pr: Маржа означает прибыль как долю от цены. Розничная прибыль указана после материалов и труда; Прайс-лист показывает прибыль после комиссии за канал и стоимости доставки, которую вы оплачиваете.
ru.Record every batch on Batch cost sheets:: Записывайте каждую партию в Таблицы себестоимости партии: стоимость единицы товара и заполните отставание от стандартной стоимости. Выход означает количество единиц товара как долю от запланированных единиц.
ru.Record the wax and fragrance weights on: Запишите вес воска и ароматизаторов на Ароматные нагрузки. Загрузка – это доля аромата в процентах от массы воска, сверенная с заданным значением.
ru.Use Lye sheets and the Lye and water she: Используйте Листы щелочи и Лист щелочи и воды в качестве простой арифметики для коэффициентов из вашего собственного листа поставщика. Ознакомьтесь с местными правилами относительно маркировки и безопасности.
ru.Log every price change on Price changes: Регистрируйте каждое изменение цены в Изменения цен и каждое изменение поставщика в Изменение цен на ингредиенты. Даты последних изменений кормят Продукты и материалы.
ru.Check Discount rules, Shipping bands, Pa: Проверьте Правила скидок, Доставка ленты, Упаковочные комплекты и Сопоставимые продукты перед продажей, новым тарифом курьерской доставки или пересмотром цен.
ru.Run Price tests: units before and during: Запустите Ценовые тесты: единицы до и во время, изменение единицы и изменение прибыли показывают, была ли уплачена новая цена.
ru.Cure days are the days a candle or soap: Дни лечения — это дни, когда свеча или мыло отдыхают, прежде чем они будут готовы. Оптовая продажа означает продажу в магазинах примерно за половину розничной цены. В трудозатраты подарочного набора входит труд его частей.
ru.Use the 14 calculators before you decide: Используйте 14 калькуляторов, прежде чем принять решение: стоимость партии, количество ароматизаторов, щелочь и вода, полная стоимость, цены по каналам, минимальная цена, скидка, подарочный набор, увеличение количества ингредиентов, бесплатная доставка, масштабирование и сетка «что, если».
ru.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Распечатайте 10 листов и 10 документов, следуйте 10 контрольным спискам и коснитесь ссылки на сообщение, чтобы открыть чат с уже написанным текстом (28 сообщений).
ru.Read the Costing and Pricing Dashboard a: Каждую неделю читайте Панель учета затрат и цен и диаграммы: прибыль по категориям и каналам, партии сверх стандартных, накладные расходы на единицу, количество ароматизаторов, рост количества ингредиентов и тесты цен.
ru.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Все выпадающие списки книги. Измените пункт здесь — он обновится на всех листах.
ru.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Данные обновляются по вашим листам. Измените год, чтобы посмотреть прошлые периоды.
ru.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Выберите значение в жёлтой ячейке — остальные заполнятся автоматически. Готово к печати.
ru.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Измените текст здесь; слова в скобках подставляются из каждой строки. Ссылки находятся в таблицах.
ru.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Выберите запись — для каждого этапа появится срок. Создайте копию листа для каждой записи.
ru.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Актуальные диаграммы по данным ваших листов. Выберите значения в жёлтых ячейках — диаграммы и индикаторы обновятся автоматически.

tr.Margin you want after materials and labo: Malzeme ve işçilikten sonra istediğiniz marj
tr.Lowest margin after channel fee and ship: Kanal ücreti ve gönderimden sonraki en düşük marj

tr.Studio costs spread over each unit made: Stüdyo maliyetleri yapılan her birime yayılır
tr.Sales tax share of retail sales (passed: Perakende satışlarda satış vergisi payı (aktarılan, saklanmayan)

tr.One row for each candle or wax melt batc: Balmumu ve kokunun tartıldığı her mum veya balmumu eriyiği partisi için bir sıra; yük (mum ağırlığının payı olarak koku ağırlığı), hedefle olan boşluk, kontrol ve koku maliyeti doldurulur.

tr.One soap batch per row with the oil weig: Yağ ağırlığı ve tedarikçi sayfanızdaki faktörlerle birlikte sıra başına bir sabun partisi; sodalı su ve su basit aritmetik olarak doldurulur. Kendi yerel kurallarınızı kontrol edin.

tr.One row for each month with rent, utilit: Kira, kamu hizmetleri, yazılım, sigorta, pazarlama ve diğer maliyetler ile yapılan birimleri içeren her ay için bir satır; toplam ve birim başına genel gider, her ürünün tam maliyetini doldurur ve besler.

tr.The shipping price you charge and the co: Aldığınız kargo ücreti ve her yöntem ve ağırlık aralığı için kargo ücreti; boşluğu dolduruyor ve para kaybeden grupların bayrağını dolduruyor.

tr.The discount codes and offers by channel: Minimum sipariş ve tarihlerle birlikte kanallara göre indirim kodları ve teklifler; durumunu, kalan gün sayısını ve sahibine sormadan verdiğiniz en büyük indirimi kontrol edin.
tr.One row for each change of a price in a: Bir kanaldaki her fiyat değişikliği için eski ve yeni fiyatı, sebebini ve kimin değiştirdiğini gösteren bir satır; değişim yüzdesi ve yönü doldurulur.
tr.One row for each change of a material co: Bir malzeme maliyetinin eski ve yeni maliyeti ve nedeni ile her değişimi için bir satır; tedarikçi, telefonu, değişiklik yüzdesi ve yön doldurulur ve son değişiklik Malzemeler'e beslenir.

tr.One row for each comparable product seen: Bir mağazada veya internette görülen, boyutu ve fiyatıyla birlikte görülen her benzer ürün için bir satır; 100 gramın fiyatı, bizim fiyatımız ve aradaki boşluğu dolduruyor, böylece nerede ucuz veya pahalı olduğunuzu görüyorsunuz.

tr.The 12 suppliers with contact, phone, le: İletişim, telefon, teslimat günleri ve ödeme koşulları olan 12 tedarikçi; Her birinin tedarik ettiği malzemeler ve son 90 gündeki fiyat artışları doldurulur.

tr.The 12 months with the demand factor and: 12 ay, talep faktörü ve sezonla birlikte; Ortalama bir ayın üstündeki veya altındaki pay doluyor.

tr.Cure days are the days a candle or soap: Kür günleri, bir mumun veya sabunun hazır olmadan önce dinlendiği günlerdir. Toptan satış, mağazalara perakende fiyatının yaklaşık yarısı kadar satış yapmak anlamına gelir. Bir hediye setinin işçilik tutanaklarına parçaların işçiliği de dahildir.

tr.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Bu dosyadaki tüm açılır listeler. Bir öğenin adını burada değiştirin; değişiklik tüm sayfalara yansır.

tr.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Metni burada düzenleyin; {braces} içindeki ifadeler her satırdaki verilerle doldurulur. Bağlantılar tablolardadır.
tr.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Bir kayıt seçin: her adımın tamamlanma tarihi buna göre belirlenir. Her kayıt için bu sayfanın bir kopyasını oluşturun.

es.Open Start and type your company name an: Abra Inicio y escriba el nombre de su empresa y sus propios números en las celdas amarillas: pago del fabricante, margen objetivo, margen más bajo, carga de fragancia, tarifa de tarjeta, tarifa de mercado, gastos generales por unidad e impuesto sobre las ventas.
es.Keep Materials current: type the cost pe: Mantener materiales actualizados: escriba el costo por kilogramo o pieza. Líneas de fórmula, Productos y cada margen se actualizan a la vez.
es.Check Formula lines for each product (qu: Marque Líneas de fórmula para cada producto (cantidad en kilogramos o piezas para un lote, un lote es una ejecución de producción con su propio número de lote), luego lea Productos: costo unitario, costo total, márgenes y precio para su objetivo.
es.Margin means profit as a share of the pr: Margen significa beneficio como parte del precio. El margen minorista es después de los materiales y la mano de obra; el Lista de precios muestra el margen después de la tarifa del canal y el envío que absorbes.
es.Record every batch on Batch cost sheets:: Registre cada lote en Hojas de costos de lote: complete el costo por unidad buena y la diferencia con el costo estándar. Rendimiento significa unidades buenas como proporción de las unidades planificadas.
es.Record the wax and fragrance weights on: Registre los pesos de cera y fragancia en Cargas de fragancia. La carga es el peso de la fragancia como proporción del peso de la cera, comparado con su objetivo.
es.Use Lye sheets and the Lye and water she: Utilice Hojas de lejía y Hoja de lejía y agua. como aritmética simple en los factores de su propia hoja de proveedor. Consulte sus propias normas locales sobre etiquetas y seguridad.
es.Log every price change on Price changes: Registre cada cambio de precio en Cambios de precio y cada cambio de proveedor en Cambios precio ingredientes. Las fechas del último cambio alimentan Productos y Materiales.
es.Check Discount rules, Shipping bands, Pa: Consulta Reglas de descuento, bandas de envío, Kits de embalaje y Productos comparables antes de una oferta, una nueva tarifa de mensajería o una revisión de precios.
es.Run Price tests: units before and during: Ejecute Pruebas de precios: unidades antes y durante, el cambio de unidad y el cambio de beneficio muestran si se pagó un nuevo precio.
es.Cure days are the days a candle or soap: Los días de cura son los días en que una vela o un jabón reposa antes de estar listo. Mayorista significa vender a tiendas a aproximadamente la mitad del precio minorista. Los minutos de mano de obra de un set de regalo incluyen la mano de obra de sus piezas.
es.Use the 14 calculators before you decide: Utilice las 14 calculadoras antes de decidir: costo del lote, carga de fragancia, lejía y agua, costo total, precios por canal, precio mínimo, descuento, set de regalo, aumento de ingredientes, envío gratuito, escala y una cuadrícula de hipótesis.
es.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Imprima 10 hojas y 10 documentos, siga 10 listas de verificación y toque el enlace de un mensaje para abrir un chat con el texto ya escrito (28 mensajes).
es.Read the Costing and Pricing Dashboard a: Lea el Panel de costos y precios y los gráficos cada semana: márgenes por categoría y canal, lotes superiores al estándar, gastos generales por unidad, carga de fragancias, aumentos de ingredientes y pruebas de precios.
es.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Todas las listas desplegables del archivo. Cambia aquí el nombre de un elemento y se actualizará en todas las hojas.
es.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Se actualiza con los datos de tus hojas. Cambia el año para consultar años anteriores.
es.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Elige en la celda amarilla; el resto se completa automáticamente. Listo para imprimir.
es.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Edita aquí el texto; las palabras entre {llaves} se completan con los datos de cada fila. Los enlaces están en las tablas.
es.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Elige un registro: cada paso tendrá su fecha límite. Haz una copia de esta hoja para cada caso.
es.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Gráficos actualizados con los datos de tus hojas. Elige en las celdas amarillas y los gráficos e indicadores se actualizarán automáticamente.

de.the lowest price with no loss, the lowes: Der niedrigste Preis ohne Verlust, der niedrigste Preis für Ihre Mindestmarge und die Einheiten pro Monat, die Ihre Fixkosten decken
de.units before and during a test at a new: Einheiten vor und während eines Tests zu einem neuen Preis zeigen Mengen- und Gewinnänderung, so wird eine Preiserhöhung sichtbar, die mehr Umsatz kostete
de.each method and weight band compares the: Jede Methode und jedes Gewichtsband vergleicht den von Ihnen berechneten Preis mit den Kurierkosten und markiert die Bänder, die Geld verlieren

de.Type the average order, the courier cost: Geben Sie die durchschnittliche Bestellung, die Kurierkosten, Ihre Kosten, Ihre Marge vor dem Versand und den gewünschten Gewinn ein. Sehen Sie sich den entgangenen Gewinn und den Bestellwert an, bei dem sich der kostenlose Versand auszahlt.

de.Margin means profit as a share of the pr: Unter Marge versteht man den Gewinn als Anteil am Preis. Die Einzelhandelsmarge ergibt sich nach Material und Arbeit; Die Preisliste zeigt die Marge nach der Kanalgebühr und den von Ihnen übernommenen Versandkosten.
de.Record every batch on Batch cost sheets:: Erfassen Sie jede Charge auf Chargenkostenblätter: die Kosten pro Guteinheit und die Lücke zu den Standardkosten. Ausbeute bedeutet Guteinheiten als Anteil der geplanten Einheiten.

nl.Tell the assistants the new prices: Vertel de assistenten de nieuwe prijzen
nl.Weigh every material of the first batch: Weeg elk materiaal van de eerste batch
nl.Time the labour per unit: Tijd van de arbeid per eenheid
nl.Set the price for your target margin: Stel de prijs in voor uw doelmarge
nl.Check the margin in every channel: Controleer de marge in elk kanaal
nl.Add the product to the price list: Voeg het product toe aan de prijslijst
nl.Collect the price lists of the suppliers: Verzamel de prijslijsten van de leveranciers
nl.Note every rise above 3 percent: Let op elke stijging boven de 3 procent
nl.Read the effect on the product margins: Lees het effect op de productmarges
nl.Ask the suppliers about the biggest rise: Vraag de leveranciers naar de grootste stijgingen
nl.Decide which prices to raise: Bepaal welke prijzen u wilt verhogen
nl.Tell the team what changed: Vertel het team wat er is veranderd
nl.Tell the wholesale shops in writing: Vertel dit schriftelijk aan de groothandels
nl.Check the first orders at the new price: Controleer de eerste bestellingen tegen de nieuwe prijs
nl.List the components of the set: Noem de componenten van de set
nl.Add the retail value of the parts: Voeg de winkelwaarde van de onderdelen toe
nl.Cost the box, tissue and label: Kosten de doos, het tissue en het etiket
nl.Check the saving for the customer: Controleer de besparing voor de klant
nl.Update the overhead of the three months: Update de overhead van de drie maanden
nl.Check the shipping bands against the cou: Controleer de verzendbanden tegen de koerier
nl.Update the settings and tell the team: Update de instellingen en vertel het team
nl.Check the margin with the discount calcu: Controleer de marge met de kortingscalculator
nl.Check the stock of the products on offer: Controleer de voorraad van de aangeboden producten
nl.Set the dates and the minimum order: Stel de data en de minimale bestelling in
nl.Update the web shop and the marketplace: Update de webshop en de marktplaats
nl.Review the sales when it ends: Bekijk de uitverkoop wanneer deze eindigt
nl.List the marketplace prices: Vermeld de prijzen op de markt
nl.Check the fee and the shipping: Controleer de kosten en de verzendkosten
nl.Read the margin after the fee: Lees de marge na de vergoeding
nl.Find the rows under the minimum margin: Zoek de rijen onder de minimummarge
nl.Change the prices that need it: Verander de prijzen die dit nodig hebben
nl.Check the margin a month later: Controleer de marge een maand later
nl.Read the load and the gap to the target: Lees de belasting en de afstand tot het doel af
nl.Weigh again if the gap is over your limi: Weeg opnieuw als het verschil uw limiet overschrijdt
nl.Note the cost of the fragrance: Let op de kosten van de geur
nl.Tell the maker about repeated gaps: Vertel de maker over herhaalde hiaten
nl.Check the comparable products again: Bekijk de vergelijkbare producten nog eens
nl.List the products not re-priced for 12 m: Vermeld de producten die gedurende 12 maanden niet opnieuw geprijsd zijn
nl.Read the year of price and cost changes: Lees het jaar van prijs- en kostenwijzigingen
nl.Set next year prices for each category: Stel de prijzen voor volgend jaar in voor elke categorie
nl.Tell the team, the shops and the account: Vertel het aan het team, de winkels en de accountant
nl.Products at or above the target margin: Producten op of boven de doelmarge
nl.Price rows meeting the minimum margin: Prijsrijen die voldoen aan de minimummarge
nl.Batches at or under standard cost: Batches tegen of onder de standaardprijs
nl.Margin after fee and shipping by channel: Marge na vergoeding en verzending per kanaal
nl.Batch cost per good unit against standar: Batchkosten per goede eenheid versus standaard per maand
nl.Batches above standard cost by month: Batches boven de standaardkosten per maand
nl.Ingredient price rises by month: De prijs van ingrediënten stijgt met de maand
nl.Open Start and type your company name an: Open Start en typ uw bedrijfsnaam en uw eigen nummers in de gele cellen: makerbetaling, doelmarge, laagste marge, geurbelasting, kaartkosten, marktplaatskosten, overhead per eenheid en omzetbelasting.
nl.Keep Materials current: type the cost pe: Houd materialen actueel: typ de kosten per kilogram of stuk. Formule lijnen, Producten en elke marge-update in één keer.
nl.Check Formula lines for each product (qu: Controleer Formule lijnen voor elk product (hoeveelheid in kilogram of stuks voor één batch, een batch is één productierun met een eigen batchnummer) en lees vervolgens Producten: eenheidskosten, volledige kosten, marges en de prijs voor uw doel.
nl.Margin means profit as a share of the pr: Marge betekent winst als deel van de prijs. De detailhandelsmarge is gebaseerd op materialen en arbeid; de Prijslijst toont de marge na de kanaalkosten en de verzendkosten die u absorbeert.
nl.Record every batch on Batch cost sheets:: Registreer elke batch op Batchkostenbladen: de kosten per goede eenheid en het verschil met de standaardkosten worden ingevuld. Opbrengst betekent goede eenheden als aandeel van de geplande eenheden.
nl.Record the wax and fragrance weights on: Noteer het was- en geurgewicht op Geurladingen. De lading is het geurgewicht als percentage van het wasgewicht, vergeleken met uw doel.
nl.Use Lye sheets and the Lye and water she: Gebruik Lye-vellen en de Loog en waterblad als eenvoudige rekensom voor de factoren uit uw eigen leveranciersblad. Controleer uw eigen lokale regels voor labels en veiligheid.
nl.Log every price change on Price changes: Registreer elke prijswijziging op Prijswijzigingen en elke leverancierswijziging op Prijswijzigingen ingrediënten. De laatste wijzigingsdata voeden Producten en Materialen.
nl.Check Discount rules, Shipping bands, Pa: Controleer Kortingsregels, Verzendbanden, Verpakkingssets en Vergelijkbare producten vóór een uitverkoop, een nieuw koerierstarief of een prijsherziening.
nl.Run Price tests: units before and during: Run Prijs testen: eenheden voor en tijdens de eenheidswijziging en de winstwijziging laten zien of er een nieuwe prijs is betaald.
nl.Cure days are the days a candle or soap: Kuurdagen zijn de dagen waarop een kaars of zeep rust voordat deze klaar is. Groothandel betekent verkopen aan winkels tegen ongeveer de helft van de winkelprijs. Arbeidsminuten van een cadeauset omvatten de arbeid van de onderdelen.
nl.Use the 14 calculators before you decide: Gebruik de 14 calculators voordat u beslist: batchkosten, geurbelasting, loog en water, volledige kosten, prijzen per kanaal, minimumprijs, korting, cadeauset, stijging van ingrediënten, gratis verzending, schaling en een wat-als-raster.
nl.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Druk 10 vellen en 10 documenten af, volg 10 checklists en tik op een berichtlink om een ​​chat te openen met de reeds geschreven tekst (28 berichten).
nl.Read the Costing and Pricing Dashboard a: Lees elke week de Kosten- en prijsdashboard en de grafieken: marges per categorie en kanaal, batches boven de norm, overhead per eenheid, geurbelasting, stijgingen van ingrediënten en prijstests.
nl.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Alle keuzelijsten in dit bestand. Wijzig hier een item en de wijziging wordt op elk werkblad doorgevoerd.
nl.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Wordt bijgewerkt vanuit je werkbladen. Wijzig het jaar om terug te kijken.
nl.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Kies in de gele cel; de rest wordt automatisch ingevuld. Klaar om af te drukken.
nl.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Pas de tekst hier aan; woorden tussen {accolades} worden ingevuld vanuit elke rij. De koppelingen staan in de tabellen.
nl.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Kies een registratie: voor elke stap wordt de uiterste datum berekend. Maak voor elke registratie een kopie van dit werkblad.
nl.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Actuele grafieken op basis van je werkbladen. Kies in de gele cellen en alle grafieken en meters worden automatisch vernieuwd.
